common.name: Name
common.head: Head
common.start_not_confirmed: The job did not start: the machine does not show it running. Check the state and try again.
common.start_cancelled_by_machine: The job started but the machine cancelled it (check the laser guard messages).

needs.tap_again_g28_moves_all_axes: Tap again: G28 MOVES all axes
needs.mode_needs_change_it_from_the: mode {cur}: needs {mode} (change it from the bar)
needs.clears_a_possible_bltouch_alarm_and: Clears a possible BLTouch alarm and stows the pin (M280 S160 + M402). Does not move the axes.
needs.use_the_focus_height_of_the: Use the focus height of the macro {macro}: {h} mm above the surface.
needs.go_height_confirm: Tap again: Z goes to {hv} mm WITHOUT measuring
needs.go_height_tip: Moves only Z to {hv} mm (machine coordinates), without using the probe. WARNING: it is only right if this material was already measured with this zone and Z was not homed again afterwards; if not, the laser ends up at another height and can hit the material.
needs.focusing_the_probe_measures_the_surface: Focusing: the probe measures the surface and the laser ends up {hv} mm above it...
needs.done_laser_mm_above_the_measured: Done: laser {hv} mm above the measured surface (if nothing changed, check the console).
needs.first_stows_the_bltouch_pin_if: First stows the BLTouch pin if it was out; then measures the surface with the BLTouch where it is now (without moving X/Y; it touches at head + probe offset) and leaves the laser at that height. Same as Measure and focus, but here.
needs.g28_homes_all_axes_the_machine: G28: homes all axes (the machine moves to the end stops). Clear the travel.

zonesPage.measure_here_tip: The probe goes to this point, touches the surface and leaves the laser at the focus height. It does not save the point or change the zone.
zonesPage.points_assistant_tip: In the Laser editor and Find center the point dialog (Z point, origin, go here...) does not open by itself while you move shapes. Turn it on when you need it: then it opens with a right click or a long press.
zonesPage.no_material_macro_measure_and_focus: No material macro: 'Measure and focus' (and live jobs) can't focus this zone. Give it a material with focus or create the macro in Z height and focus.
zonesPage.the_material_macro_is_a_file: The material macro is a file in macros/laser/ that activates this zone, measures the material with the probe at its Z point and leaves the laser at focus height. It is run by 'Measure and focus' and by the Start GCode of live jobs. It builds itself: just pick the material (or type the focus height).
zonesPage.it_s_the_machine_s_offsets: It's the machine's (Offsets > Laser and pointer): change it there and it applies to all zones.
zonesPage.the_active_zone_is_always_shown: The active zone is always shown in full. Automatic: with names on the Zones tab, outline only on the others.
zonesPage.closes_the_live_job_that_was: Closes the live job that was left open (for example if the program did not send the end). It is recorded in Activity counted up to its last activity.
zonesPage.closes_the_live_job_that_was_no_activity: Closes the live job that was left open (for example if the program did not send the end).
zonesPage.while_a_job_runs_the_map: While a job runs, the map shows only the toolpath, the head, the active zone and what must not be hit. Show everything shows the rest.
zonesPage.zooms_the_map_to_what_is: Zooms the map to what is being cut (it zooms in by itself when a job starts).
zonesPage.only_on_this_screen_what_shows: Only on this screen. What shows on the map is in Layers.
zonesPage.automatic_if_the_bar_doesn_t: Automatic: if the bar doesn't fit in one row, only the icons stay (the name shows when you hold your finger or the mouse over it).
zonesPage.saves_the_current_framing_up_to: Saves the current framing (up to 4, this screen only).
zonesPage.no_photo_yet_it_is_built: No photo yet: it is built in Vision (bed mosaic).
zonesPage.there_is_no_bed_photo_yet: There is no bed photo yet: it is built in Vision (mosaic).
zonesPage.the_photo_of_the_whole_bed_2: The photo of the whole bed that Vision builds, as background. Opacity and more in Layers.
zonesPage.zooms_the_map_to_the_origin: Zooms the map to the origin of the active zone.
zonesPage.the_machine_is_busy_or_a: The machine is busy or a job is running.
zonesPage.opens_active_zone_at_the_set: Opens Active zone at the Set origin step: you choose whether the point is the laser's or the pointer's and it is checked before saving.
zonesPage.offset_removed_to_locate_or_check: Offset REMOVED (to locate or check): X0 Y0 = where the pointer falls. Doesn't move the machine.
zonesPage.offset_applied_how_you_cut_x0: Offset APPLIED (how you cut): X0 Y0 = where the laser hits. Doesn't move the machine.
zonesPage.tap_a_point_on_the_map: Tap a point on the map (with View, Point or Measure) and come back here to go there.
zonesPage.takes_the_pointer_to_the_point: Takes the POINTER to the point (laser off; raises Z 5 mm and lowers it on arrival). Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.one_tap_one_step_with_the: One tap = one step, with the laser off. Z moves at most 10 mm per tap.
zonesPage.map_size_on_this_screen_small_2: Map size on this screen: small, medium, large or hidden.
zonesPage.show_or_hide_the_section_panel: Show or hide the section panel in full screen.
zonesPage.full_screen_with_the_section_panel: Full screen, with the section panel beside it (Esc to exit).
zonesPage.map_settings_on_this_screen_view: Map settings on this screen: view (minimap, rotate, mirror), theme, bed background, clamps and button names.
zonesPage.undoes_the_last_change_to_the: Undoes the last change to the Editor shapes.
zonesPage.map_view_whole_bed_active_zone: Map view: whole bed, active zone, follow the head, rotate, the bed photo and saved views.
zonesPage.zoom_in_also_with_the_mouse: Zoom in (also with the mouse wheel or by pinching).
zonesPage.active_zone_change_zone_laser_offset: Active zone: change zone, laser offset, go to X0 Y0 and set the origin.
zonesPage.move_the_machine_from_here_steps: Move the machine from here: steps in X, Y and Z (one tap = one step) and go to the last point tapped on the map.
zonesPage.magnet_taps_and_measurements_snap_to: Magnet: taps and measurements snap to the references (bed center, X0 Y0 of the zones, corners and center of the area). Turns the References layer on or off.
zonesPage.the_map_and_the_section_panel: The map and the section panel fill the screen, so you can finish what you are doing without leaving. Esc or the same button to exit.
zonesPage.in_full_screen_shows_or_hides: In full screen: shows or hides the section panel (Find center, Work area, Editor...) next to the map.
zonesPage.puts_the_map_back_to_the: Puts the map back to the usual view (not rotated or mirrored).
zonesPage.rotates_the_map_90_per_tap: Rotates the map 90° per tap (in Layers: mirror, theme and bed background).
zonesPage.what_shows_on_the_map_and: What shows on the map (and ready-made layer sets). It closes by itself when you tap outside.
zonesPage.the_wheel_on_the_image_raises: The wheel on the image raises or lowers the camera; outside the image, map zoom.
zonesPage.the_machine_follows_the_image_while: The machine follows the image while you drag it, without the Move box. Asks for a double tap because it moves the machine.
zonesPage.each_move_shows_where_it_goes: Each move shows where it goes (light blue box) and asks you to tap Move twice. Nothing moves on its own.
zonesPage.resolution_of_the_incoming_video_and: Resolution of the incoming video and how big one pixel is on the bed at this Z height (higher = more area and less detail). The smallest thing you can locate is ~2 px.
zonesPage.raises_z_30_mm_the_camera: Raises Z 30 mm: the camera sees more area (less detail).
zonesPage.no_camera_image_at_this_height: No camera image at this height (calibrate the second height in Vision).
zonesPage.drag_the_image_up_down_or: Drag the image (up/down) or tap where you want to look.
zonesPage.drag_the_image_or_tap_where: Drag the image or tap where you want to look.
zonesPage.drag_the_image_up_down_the: Drag the image (up/down): the machine goes there. Wheel or pinch on the image: raises or lowers Z.
zonesPage.drag_the_image_the_machine_goes: Drag the image: the machine goes there. Wheel or pinch on the image: raises or lowers Z.
zonesPage.live_the_machine_follows_the_camera: LIVE: the machine follows the camera. Dragging, the wheel or tapping move it without asking for confirmation.
zonesPage.moves_the_gantry_with_the_camera: Moves the GANTRY with the camera (laser off). When going up, Z first and then Y.
zonesPage.moves_the_carriage_with_the_camera: Moves the CARRIAGE with the camera (laser off). When going up, Z first and then X/Y.
zonesPage.x_y_and_z_need_homing: X, Y and Z need homing.
zonesPage.not_moving_the_machine_is_busy: Not moving: the machine is busy
zonesPage.live_the_machine_is_busy_or: Live: the machine is busy or a job is running.
zonesPage.live_y_and_z_are_not: Live: Y and Z are not homed.
zonesPage.live_x_y_and_z_are: Live: X, Y and Z are not homed.
zonesPage.shows_the_camera_and_its_panel: Shows the camera and its panel. Drag the image (or tap where you want to look) to move the machine with the camera; the wheel or a pinch on the image raise or lower Z. Works in every section. Moving asks for a second tap; Live is marked in amber while it is on. Another tap closes it.
zonesPage.measure_it_in_machine: Measure it in Machine, Work area.
zonesPage.edit_needs_machine: Install the Machine plugin to measure or change the work area.
zonesPage.the_part_of_the_bed_you: The part of the bed you can work on in each mode (bed coords = where the pointer lands). Zones (validation), Frame, the mesh and the zone warnings use it.
zonesPage.map_size_on_this_screen_small: Map size on this screen: small, medium, large or hidden. The tab's panel scrolls underneath it.
zonesPage.when_measuring_the_machine_compares_the: When measuring, the machine compares the measured thickness with the material's and warns if they differ.
zonesPage.assigning_a_material_to_a_zone: Assigning a material to a zone writes its focus into the zone macro.
zonesPage.the_material_library_thickness_focus_pow: The material library: thickness, focus, power and speed (laser) or safe height and feeds (CNC).
zonesPage.on_the_map_you_can_drag: On the map you can drag a corner of the area: when you let go it asks Save or Cancel.
zonesPage.frame_runs_along_the_outline_to: Frame runs along the outline to check it.
zonesPage.it_is_the_bed_rectangle_where: It is the bed rectangle where you can work in each mode (Laser, CNC).
zonesPage.each_step_checks_itself_when_done: Each step checks itself when done; the ones that move the machine ask for a second tap.
zonesPage.step_by_step_before_cutting_machine: Step by step before cutting: machine ready (homing), zone, material, measure and focus, check with the pointer.
zonesPage.it_works_the_same_for_file: It works the same for file jobs and live jobs (over the network or USB).
zonesPage.laser_by_power_and_cnc_by_depth: Laser by power and CNC by depth.
zonesPage.shows_on_the_map_the_path: Shows on the map the path of the running job (or the last one): what is done in bold and what is left faint.
zonesPage.dragging_a_zone_s_origin_opens: Dragging a zone's origin opens its editor with the new point; it is saved only when you tap Save.
zonesPage.on_the_map_press_and_hold: On the map: press and hold (or right-click) on a point opens its menu; on a zone, its card.
zonesPage.positions_saved_machine_places_to_go: Positions: saved machine places to go back to with one tap.
zonesPage.all_zones_the_table_to_use: All zones: the table to use, copy, edit or delete any zone, and see its history.
zonesPage.active_zone_the_one_the_machine: Active zone: the one the machine uses now. From there you go to zero (X0 Y0), measure the Z height and set the origin where the pointer is.
zonesPage.a_zone_g55_to_g59_3: A zone (G55 to G59.3) is a saved origin: where the job starts, with its name, material and focus.
zonesPage.mark_clamps_screws_or_stops_on: Mark clamps, screws or stops on the map so it warns if a zone, the Laser editor or a job goes over them. Off: they're not shown and don't warn.
zonesPage.no_clamps_marked_yet: No clamps marked yet: tap a point on the map and choose "Mark clamp here". A red 30 x 20 mm rectangle is drawn; tap it to adjust.
zonesPage.n_clamps_marked: Clamps marked: {n}. Tap one on the map to adjust or delete it.
zonesPage.mirrors_the_map_left_to_right: Mirrors the map left to right.
zonesPage.rotates_the_map_to_match_how: Rotates the map to match how you see the machine from this screen. Text stays upright.
zonesPage.show_or_hide_the_small_overview: Show or hide the small overview box (bottom right, when zoomed).
zonesPage.bed_zones_head_probe_z_point: Bed, zones, head, probe, Z point and work areas (the default).
zonesPage.everything_useful_for_measuring_referenc: Everything useful for measuring: references, positions and Z point.
zonesPage.just_what_you_need_to_cut: Just what you need to cut: zones, head, Z point and the work area.
zonesPage.changes_where_the_camera_is_mounted: Changes where the camera is mounted (Vision saves it). Then it must be calibrated again. Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.camera_video_under_the_map_it: Camera video under the map. It's set up and calibrated in Vision.
zonesPage.leftover_material_pieces_the_laser_edito: Leftover material pieces: the Laser editor tells which ones the shapes fit in. Tap the map > Mark offcut here.
zonesPage.clamps_screws_or_stops_warns_if: Clamps, screws or stops: warns if a zone or a job goes over them. Tap the map > Mark clamp here.
zonesPage.the_photo_of_the_whole_bed: The photo of the whole bed that Vision builds (mosaic): as background, to place parts and offcuts.
zonesPage.where_the_probe_touches_head_g31: Where the probe touches: head + G31 offset of the active mode.
zonesPage.cross_pointer_red_dot_where_the: Cross = pointer; red dot = where the laser hits (if the laser-pointer correction is saved, Offsets).
zonesPage.sets_x_y_to_where_the: Sets X Y to where the pointer is now (then tap Save).
zonesPage.check_the_numbers_width_and_height: Check the numbers (width and height greater than 0).
zonesPage.x_y_bottom_left_corner_where: X Y = bottom-left corner, where the pointer lands (mm).
zonesPage.starts_a_measurement_at_this_point: Starts a measurement at this point: tap the other end.
zonesPage.marks_a_leftover_piece_of_material: Marks a leftover piece of material with its bottom-left corner here (100 x 60 mm; adjust the size afterwards). The Laser editor tells whether the shapes fit.
zonesPage.marks_a_30_x_20_mm: Marks a 30 x 20 mm clamp (or screw, stop) centered here; adjust its size afterwards. The map warns if a zone or a job goes over it.
zonesPage.assistant_laser_only_cuts_in_parts: Assistant, laser only: cuts in parts a design larger than the work area; you mark 2 points of the piece and between parts the camera locates it again.
zonesPage.the_cut_area_of_each_mode: The work area of each mode: measure (pointer, laser, by hand, map), frame and test.
zonesPage.work_zones_g55_editor_table_and: Work zones (G55...): editor, table and saved positions.
zonesPage.workbench_lead: Place the job on the bed, set the origin and the height, and follow the cut on the map.
zonesPage.outside_the_travel_to_point_with: {t} outside the travel ({min} to {max}): point {t2}, with laser offset {v}
zonesPage.point_outside_the_cut_area_x: point outside the work area (X {area} to {area2}, Y {area3} to {area4})
zonesPage.step_by_step_to_get_a: Step by step to get a zone ready before cutting: machine, zone, material, measure/focus, check with the pointer.
zonesPage.draw_or_import_svg_shapes_sort: Draw or import (SVG) shapes, sort them in colour layers and cut them with the laser.
zonesPage.measure_a_hole_or_a_piece: Measure a hole or a piece with the pointer to know its centre and size.
zonesPage.what_is_being_cut_now_or: What is being cut now (or the last job): path on the map by power, speed, air and a report.
zonesPage.materials_library_thickness_focus_powers: Materials library: thickness, focus, powers (laser) or safe height and feeds (CNC).
zonesPage.takes_the_pointer_to_this_point: Takes the POINTER to this point (laser off; raises Z 5 mm and lowers it on arrival). Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.z_measuring_point_and_focus_in: Z measuring point (and focus in Laser) of {code}: the PROBE touches here. Does not move the machine; it is measured with the Active zone button.
zonesPage.adds_it_to_the_saved_positions: Adds it to the saved positions (with the current Z), to come back later with one tap.
zonesPage.opens_the_zones_editor_with_this: Opens the zones editor with this point as origin (X/Y loaded). You save it.
zonesPage.takes_the_machine_to_this_position: Takes the machine to this position: raises Z, moves in X/Y and lowers. Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.mm_on_the_edges_adapts_to: mm on the edges (adapts to the zoom).
zonesPage.the_one_of_the_active_mode: The one of the active mode, more marked.
zonesPage.rectangle_material_if_it_has_a: Rectangle = material (if it has a size), circle = its point. Tap it to see data and actions.
zonesPage.where_the_probe_measures_in_the: Where the probe measures in the active zone.
zonesPage.centres_and_corners_the_taps_snap: Centres and corners: the taps snap to them.
zonesPage.what_the_vision_page_detected_pieces: What the Vision page detected (pieces, holes, circles, marks...). Tap it to go, save or use it.
zonesPage.rotated_the_ruler_shows_which_axis: Rotated {mapRot}°{v}. The ruler shows which axis each edge is.
zonesPage.the_same_as_the_jog_machine: the same as the jog -- machine coordinates (where the pointer was)
zonesPage.there_are_no_positions_take_the: There are no positions. Take the pointer to a point (jog) and tap 'Save the current position'. On the map they show as orange diamonds (Positions layer).
zonesPage.going_to_raises_z_moves_in: Going to {name} (raises Z, moves in X/Y and lowers).
zonesPage.takes_the_machine_to_this_position_2: Takes the machine to this position: first raises Z, then X/Y and finally lowers. Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.updated_to_where_the_pointer_is_2: {name}: updated to where the pointer is.
zonesPage.replaces_x_y_z_of_this: Replaces X/Y/Z of this position with where the pointer is now. Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.x_y_not_homed_homes_before: X/Y not homed: homes before saving.
zonesPage.saves_where_the_pointer_is_now: Saves where the pointer is now (machine X/Y/Z).
zonesPage.cut_area_middle_of_the_left: Work area: middle of the left edge
zonesPage.cut_area_middle_of_the_right: Work area: middle of the right edge
zonesPage.cut_area_middle_of_the_bottom: Work area: middle of the bottom edge
zonesPage.cut_area_middle_of_the_top: Work area: middle of the top edge
zonesPage.to_the_edges_left_right_front: to the edges: left {v}, right {v2}, front {v3}, back {v4}
zonesPage.a_tap_here_snaps_to_this: (a tap here snaps to this point)
zonesPage.laser_hits_at_x_y_correction: Laser hits at: X{v} Y{v2}  (correction X{cx} Y{cy})
zonesPage.laser_no_laser_pointer_correction_saved: Laser: no laser-pointer correction saved (Offsets), where it hits is not drawn
zonesPage.probe_touches_at_x_y_g31: Probe touches at: X{v} Y{v2}  (G31 X{x} Y{y}, mode {mode})
zonesPage.active_zone_work_position_x_y: Active zone {code}: work position X{x} Y{y}
zonesPage.ruler_mm_on_the_edges_of: Ruler: mm on the edges of the view (adapts to the zoom). Grey: travel (M208). Coloured dotted: work area of each mode (Laser orange, CNC light blue; the one of the active mode more marked). Circles: point of each zone (material corner, where the pointer lands). White cross: pointer/head; red dot: where the laser hits. Yellow: measurement in progress.
zonesPage.tapping_the_map_does_nothing_only: Tapping the map does nothing: only look, zoom and pan.
zonesPage.tapping_the_map_opens_that_point: Tapping the map opens that point: go with the pointer, save it or use it as Z point.
zonesPage.tap_two_points_distance_dx_dy: Tap two points: distance, dX, dY and angle (they snap to the references). A third tap starts another measurement.
zonesPage.in_this_tab_the_map_taps: In this tab the map taps are used by the tab (draw, mesh region...).
zonesPage.carriage_x_x_y_y_z: Carriage: X{x} -> X{tx}, Y{y} -> Y{ty}, Z{z} -> Z{tz}
zonesPage.raises_z_to_mm_the_minimum: Raises Z to {zmin} mm (the minimum for photos): the laser stays out of focus until you focus again.
zonesPage.done_the_camera_is_now_at_2: Done: the camera is now at{v} Y{ty} Z{tz}.
zonesPage.asks_for_a_second_tap_moves: Asks for a second tap: moves the machine. {v}
zonesPage.z_is_already_at_the_limit_2: Z is already at the limit: {zt0} mm.
zonesPage.camera_carriage_at_x_y_z: Camera: carriage at X{x} Y{y} Z{z}
zonesPage.lowers_z_30_mm_never_below: Lowers Z 30 mm (never below Z{zmin}): more detail, less area.
zonesPage.on_dragging_the_image_the_wheel: On: dragging the image, the wheel, the pinch and tapping move the machine directly (laser off, Z never below {zmin} mm). Tap Confirm to ask for confirmation again.
zonesPage.the_map_centres_itself_on_the: The map centres itself on the head while it moves (with zoom). Moving it by hand turns it off.
zonesPage.lowers_z_mm_careful_with_the: Lowers Z {pz} mm: careful with the material
zonesPage.activates_in_the_machine_also_applies: {v}Activates {c} in the machine (also applies to live jobs and the other screens). Does not move anything.
zonesPage.raises_z_goes_to_x0_y0_tap: Raises Z and goes to X0 Y0 of {code}: the {target} ends up over the zone point. Asks for a second tap.
zonesPage.switches_to_does_not_move_the: Switches to {code} (does not move the machine).
zonesPage.activates_and_goes_to_its_x0: Activates {code} and goes to its X0 Y0 (raises Z first).
zonesPage.goes_around_the_edge_of_the: Goes around the edge of the material with the POINTER (laser off, raises Z 5 mm).
zonesPage.the_path_goes_over_pause_if: ⚠ The path goes over {list}. Pause if it is not expected.
zonesPage.it_has_an_offset_in_memory: It has an offset in memory but no file: it is lost on restart.
zonesPage.activates_and_moves_the_machine_to: Activates {code} and MOVES the machine to its X0 Y0 (raises Z first). Head/pointer ends at X{offX} Y{offY}.
zonesPage.laser_offset_applied_the_laser_hits: Laser offset APPLIED: the LASER hits X{v} Y{v2} (the zone point); the pointer stays shifted.
zonesPage.laser_offset_removed_the_pointer_stays: Laser offset REMOVED: the POINTER stays over the zone point.
zonesPage.choose_a_zone_in_the_table: Choose a zone in the table or on the map (Edit), or create a new one. The changes are saved in sys/workshop/zones/pN.g with a backup in sys/workshop/zones/history/.
zonesPage.there_are_no_free_zones_g55: There are no free zones (G55..G59.3 have a file). Delete or edit an existing one.
zonesPage.no_measure_and_focus_laserfocus_g: (no Measure and focus: laserfocus.g only reaches G59)
zonesPage.set_as_the_zone_point_one: Set as the zone point one of the saved positions of the jog (the pointer was over that point).
zonesPage.towards_x_from_the_zone_point: Towards +X from the zone point. With width and height, the map shows the outline of the material and the 'centre' reference of this zone.
zonesPage.focus_height_over_the_material_mm: Focus height over the material, mm (empty = no macro)
zonesPage.none_no_measure_and_focus_in: None (no 'Measure and focus' in this zone)
zonesPage.ask_if_there_is_material_before_focusing: Ask if there is material before focusing
Before measuring, the macro asks whether there is material on the table. If you say no, it stops without moving anything.
zonesPage.type_the_focus_height_or_choose: Type the focus height (or choose a material) to see the macro.
zonesPage.no_macro_the_zone_will_not: No macro: the zone will not have 'Measure and focus'.
zonesPage.shows_the_exact_content_of_the: Shows the exact content of the macro (the current one or the one to be created).
zonesPage.applied_origin_x_y_laser_offset: Applied origin: X{v} Y{v2} (laser offset ON) / X{refX} Y{refY} (OFF).
zonesPage.there_is_a_job_running_zones: There is a job running: zones are not changed now.
zonesPage.no_material_assigned_the_thickness_canno: No material assigned: the thickness cannot be checked when measuring.
zonesPage.the_material_is_for_and_the: The material {name} is for {materialMode} and the machine is in {mode}.
zonesPage.the_macro_focuses_at_mm_but: The macro {macro} focuses at {h} mm but the material says {focus} mm (it is fixed by choosing the material again).
zonesPage.use_the_nearest_point_the_probe_2: Use the nearest point the probe reaches: X{x} Y{y}
zonesPage.moves_the_z_point_of_and: Moves the Z point of {code} (and its material macro) to that point. Does not move the machine.
zonesPage.the_probe_bltouch_is_beside_the: The probe (BLTouch) is beside the laser, at X{x} Y{y} mm from the head. To touch the Z point (X{x2} Y{y2}), the head would have to go to X{hx} Y{hy}, outside the bed: it would measure somewhere else. Move the Z point further inside.
zonesPage.the_z_point_is_outside_the: The Z point is outside the work area of {mode}: there may be no material there.
zonesPage.no_material_size_there_is_no: No material size: there is no centre or frame of the zone on the map (Edit > size).
zonesPage.the_material_x_mm_from_the: The material ({w} x {h} mm from the zone point) goes outside the work area of {mode}.
zonesPage.the_clamp_is_over_the_material: The clamp {nm} is over the material of the zone: check that the cut does not go there.
zonesPage.the_z_point_falls_on_the: The Z point falls on {nm}: the probe would measure the clamp, not the material.
zonesPage.measure_and_focus_laserfocus_g_only: Measure and focus (laserfocus.g) only reaches G59: leave the focus height empty for {code}.
zonesPage.macros_laser_already_exists_and_is: macros/laser/{macroName} already exists and is not the macro of this zone: choose another name.
zonesPage.no_backups_yet_they_are_created: No backups yet (they are created when editing, restoring or deleting from this page).
zonesPage.the_file_is_not_valid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
zonesPage.it_is_not_a_zones_export: It is not a zones export (format taller-zonas-v1).
zonesPage.imported_zones_the_previous_ones_were: Imported {n} zones (the previous ones were kept in sys/workshop/zones/history).
zonesPage.its_macro_macros_laser_was_not: Its macro macros/laser/{macro} was not deleted: delete it by hand if you no longer use it.
zonesPage.cannot_delete_the_active_zone: {code} is the active zone: activate another zone before deleting it.
zonesPage.needs_other_plugin: This is on the {title} page ({plugin} plugin), which is not installed or is deactivated.
zonesPage.other_mode_text: The Workbench is for laser and CNC. The {mode} mode has its own page: {page}. The map still shows the bed and the head.
zonesPage.help_simulate_1: Choose a job file (.gcode): it is drawn on the map where it will land, with its size, time and distances.
zonesPage.help_simulate_2: Play runs it over time; the bar goes to any moment.
zonesPage.help_simulate_3: Frame walks the outline with the pointer (or with the laser at low power) before cutting.
zonesPage.help_simulate_note: If a part falls outside the work area, the card says so in red.
zonesPage.help_large_1: For a piece larger than the area: it is cut in parts, moving the material between one and the next.
zonesPage.help_large_2: The assistant says how to split it, where to put the marks and how to place each part (with the camera or with the pointer).

zoneActive.the_macro_measures_elsewhere: The macro measures at another point ({xy})
zoneActive.make_the_macro_measure_here: Make the macro measure at the Z point
zoneActive.measure_and_focus_runs_the_macro: "Measure and focus" runs the material macro, which has its own X/Y. This leaves it measuring at the Z point shown on the map.
zoneActive.raises_5_mm_and_measures_z: Raises 5 mm and measures Z with the BLTouch where it is (the probe touches at head + offset). Z0 = that surface.
zoneActive.z_measured_with_the_bltouch_here: Z measured with the BLTouch here.
zoneActive.laser_offset_removed_x0_y0_where: Laser offset REMOVED: X0 Y0 = where the pointer lands.
zoneActive.laser_offset_applied_x0_y0_where: Laser offset APPLIED: X0 Y0 = where the laser hits.
zoneActive.activates_another_zone_does_not_move: Activates another zone (does not move the machine).
zoneActive.focus_mm_and_thickness_mm_written: : focus {h} mm and thickness {t} mm written to its macro.
zoneActive.the_material_of_this_zone_library: The material of this zone (library in the Materials tab). In Laser it writes its focus and thickness to the zone macro; when measuring, if the thickness does not match, the machine asks before going on.
zoneActive.create_materials_in_the_materials_tab: create materials in the Materials tab
zoneActive.offset_applied_how_it_cuts_the: Offset APPLIED (how it cuts): the head goes to {xy} and the LASER lands on the zone point {xy2}. Does not move the machine.
zoneActive.offset_removed_to_locate_check_x0: Offset REMOVED (to locate/check): X0 Y0 stays on the zone point {xy} with the pointer. The material macros apply it again. Does not move the machine.
zoneActive.has_no_laser_correction_x0_y0: {code} has no laser correction: X0 Y0 is where the pointer lands.
zoneActive.raises_z_goes_to_x0_y0: Raises Z and goes to X0 Y0 of {code} (machine {xy}): the {target} ends up over the zone point.
zoneActive.laser_the_bltouch_measures_the_surface: Laser: the BLTouch measures the surface of the material at the Z point and the laser ends up at the focus height above it.
zoneActive.cnc_the_bltouch_measures_the_top: CNC: the BLTouch measures the top face of the material at the Z point; that is the Z0 of the tool (it uses the G31 Z of the CNC mode: calibrate it for the fitted bit). Then it rises to the height below.
zoneActive.has_no_zone_file_create_it: {code} has no zone file: create it (Edit / New zone) to choose its measuring point.
zoneActive.the_probe_touches_there_the_head: The probe touches there; the head goes to {xy} (probe offset X{x} Y{y} in {mode}).
zoneActive.the_head_does_not_reach_it: the head does not reach: it measures shifted inwards
zoneActive.default_x30_y30_of_the_zone: Default: X30 Y30 of the zone
zoneActive.map_coordinates_machine_coordinates_wher: Map coordinates (machine coordinates, where the pointer lands). You can also tap the map and choose 'Z point here'.
zoneActive.pointer_over_the_z_point_the: Pointer over the Z point ({xy}): the probe will touch there.
zoneActive.takes_the_pointer_to_the_z: Takes the POINTER to the Z point to see on the sheet where it will measure (laser off, raises Z 5 mm). Does not measure.
zoneActive.tip_tap_the_map_anywhere_or: Tip: tap the map anywhere (or a reference) and choose 'Z point here'.
zoneActive.measured_and_focused_laser_mm_above: Measured and focused: laser {h} mm above {name}.
zoneActive.runs_macros_laser_the_same_as: Runs macros/laser/{macro} (the same as the Start GCode of a live job): activates {code} with the offset applied, measures the sheet with the BLTouch at the Z point and leaves the laser at {h} mm.
zoneActive.created_macros_laser_with_focus_mm: Created macros/laser/{macro} with focus {hz} mm. Measure and focus already uses it.
zoneActive.measure_and_focus_laserfocus_g_only: Measure and focus (laserfocus.g) only reaches G59.
zoneActive.creates_macros_laser_g_with_measure: Creates macros/laser/{slug}.g with Measure and focus for this zone.
zoneActive.measure_z0_at_the_z_point: Measure Z0 at the Z point
zoneActive.the_height_must_be_between_1: The height must be between 1 and 60 mm.
zoneActive.measuring_and_focusing: Measuring and focusing: the probe goes down and touches; it can take a few seconds...
zoneActive.done_laser_mm_above_the_surface: Done: laser {h} mm above the surface measured at {xy}.
zoneActive.z0_measured_at_ended_up_at: Z0 measured at {xy}; ended up at {h} mm.
zoneActive.goes_to_the_z_point_the: Goes to the Z point (the probe touches at {xy}), measures with the BLTouch (Z0 = that surface) and rises to {v}. {v2}
zoneActive.focusing_the_probe_measures_the_surface: Focusing: the probe measures the surface and the laser ends up {h} mm above it...
zoneActive.done_laser_mm_above_the_measured: Done: laser {h} mm above the measured surface.
zoneActive.measures_the_surface_with_the_bltouch: Measures the surface with the BLTouch where it is now (without moving X/Y; it touches at head + probe offset) and leaves the laser at the height above.
zoneActive.g92_z0_the_current_position_becomes: G92 Z0: the current position becomes Z0 ({v}). Does not move anything.
zoneActive.point_loaded_in_the_editor_over: Point loaded in the editor ({v} over the point): {xy}. Check the validation and tap Save.
zoneActive.uses_the_current_position_as_the_2: Uses the current position as the point of {code}. It asks what is over the point (laser or pointer) and opens the editor with the point loaded, with the travel and work area validation, before saving.
zoneActive.what_is_over_the_point_now: What is over the point NOW?
zoneActive.the_point_the_laser_marks_point_2: The point the laser marks: point = head - correction = {xy}.
zoneActive.does_not_change_the_zone_or: Does not change the zone or the offset (for that: Measure and focus).
zoneActive.you_touched_the_material_with_the: you touched the material with the bit, e.g. with a sheet of paper
zoneActive.you_touched_the_surface_by_hand: you touched the surface by hand
zoneActive.why_signed_out: You are not signed in: you can only look. Sign in from the notice at the bottom to use this action.
zoneActive.why_busy: The machine is busy (a job is running or it is moving).
zoneActive.why_home_all: Home X, Y and Z first.
zoneActive.why_no_point: The zone has no Z point and no material macro: choose a point under Advanced.
zoneActive.src_typed: Value written here: it only drives these buttons, it is not saved in the zone.
zoneActive.src_rule: Thickness rule: {t} mm material (measured with the lens box).
zoneActive.src_material: Lens focus {f} mm minus {dz} mm inside ({mat}).
zoneActive.src_lens: Lens focus ({f} mm). With a material that has thickness it is worked out by itself.
zoneActive.stale_macro_runs_its_own: Without a Z point, the button runs the macro with its own height ({h} mm).
zoneActive.single_axis_in_the_jog: To move a single axis to its zero or to lower to Z0, use the Position card of the Jog.
zoneActive.advanced_summary: Z point, Z by hand and probe calibration
zoneActive.calibration_note: The trigger height of the probe and the fine adjustment are calibrated in Machine, on the Height page: they apply to every zone. The repeatability and accuracy tests of the probe are there too.

zcal.from_the_mode_file: the one of the mode file
zcal.calibrate_in_machine_tip: The height calibration (BLTouch, paper and fine adjustment) is done in Machine > Height; it measures at the Z point of this zone.

materials.material_to_cut_engrave_with_the: Material to cut/engrave with the laser: thickness, focus height and power/speed.
materials.material_for_milling_thickness_safe_heig: Material for milling: thickness, safe height, bit and feeds.
materials.the_material_macros_are_already_in: The material macros are already in the list.
materials.material_s_imported_from_the_macros: {added} material(s) imported from the macros. Check thickness and powers.
materials.creates_one_material_for_each_material: Creates one material for each material macro (macros/laser/*.g) with its focus height; the thickness comes from the name (e.g. 'MDF 3mm').
materials.each_zone_can_have_its_material: Each zone can have its material (Zones > Active zone > Material). The thickness is compared with what the probe measures: if it does not match, the machine asks before going on. The powers can be used in the layers of the Laser editor.
materials.compared_with_what_the_probe_measures: Compared with what the probe measures.
materials.how_high_the_bit_rises_after: How high the bit rises after measuring Z0 on the material.
materials.0_at_the_surface_the_focus: 0 = at the surface. The focus of the lens ({f} mm, Work zones > Offsets) is a single one; this lowers it into the material for thick cuts.
materials.focus_inside_between_0_and_mm: Focus inside: between 0 and {f} mm (the focus of the lens).
materials.tap_import_from_the_macros_to: Tap 'Import from the macros' to start with the ones you already use.
materials.zones_are_updated_with_the_new: Zones {join} are updated with the new focus and thickness.

prepare.goes_to_the_zones_tab_editor: Goes to the Zones tab: editor, table and work area.
prepare.scrolls_down_to_the_bed_map: Scrolls down to the bed map (on this same tab): it shows the zone, its Z point (magenta diamond) and the head.
prepare.follow_the_steps_in_order_each: Follow the steps in order. Each one checks itself off when done. The ones that move the machine ask for a second tap. Below is the bed map: it shows the chosen zone, its Z point (magenta diamond) and where the head is.
prepare.all_axes_homed_and_machine_free: All axes homed and machine free.
prepare.choose_the_zone_where_the_material: Choose the zone where the material is.
prepare.no_material_the_thickness_is_not: no material (the thickness is not checked)
prepare.which_material_you_are_going_to: Which material you are going to cut.
prepare.the_probe_measures_the_material_and: The probe measures the material and leaves the laser at the focus height.
prepare.the_probe_measures_the_material_z0: The probe measures the material: Z0 = the surface.
prepare.go_around_the_edge_of_the: Go around the edge of the material with the pointer (laser off).
prepare.has_no_zone_file_choose_another: {code} has no zone file. Choose another one or create it in the Zones tab.
prepare.this_material_is_for_and_the: This material is for {materialMode} and the machine is in {mode}.
prepare.measured_and_focused_laser_at_mm: Measured and focused: laser at {h} mm.
prepare.runs_macros_laser_activates_the_zone: Runs macros/laser/{macro}: activates the zone with the offset applied, measures at the Z point{xy} and leaves the laser at {h} mm.{check}
prepare.z0_measured_ended_up_at_mm: Z0 measured; ended up at {h} mm.
prepare.the_probe_touches_at_x_y: The probe touches at X{x} Y{y}, Z0 = the surface, and rises to {h} mm.
prepare.goes_around_the_edge_of_the: Goes around the edge of the material of {code} with the POINTER (raises Z 5 mm, laser off), to check it is where it should be.
prepare.the_zone_has_no_material_size: The zone has no material size: you can go to the origin with the pointer (or enter the size in Zones > Edit).
prepare.laser_offset_applied_x0_y0_where: Laser offset applied: X0 Y0 = where the laser hits.
prepare.live_job_from_your_sending_program_2: Live job (from your sending program): send it to zone {code} (its material macro already has the focus{v}).
prepare.send_the_job_with_the_origin: Send the job with the origin in {code}.
prepare.check_that_the_thickness_is_mm: Check that the thickness is {thickness} mm.
prepare.does_not_match_check_the_material: -- does NOT match, check the material

cameraMap.off_turn_it_on_in_vision: Off: turn it on in Vision with the In Work zones switch (top) or in Settings > Work zones map.
cameraMap.set_it_up_on_the_vision: Set it up on the Vision page (Camera).
cameraMap.the_camera_is_on_the_carriage: The camera is on the carriage but the calibration has no X: calibrate again in Vision.
cameraMap.vision_has_no_calibration_for_there: Vision has no calibration for {w}×{h} (there is one for {sizes}).
cameraMap.the_camera_is_not_calibrated_calibrate: The camera is not calibrated: calibrate it in Vision.
cameraMap.not_possible_with_z_at_the: Not possible with Z at {z} (the calibration is at Z{z2}): calibrate the second height in Vision.
cameraMap.invalid_lens_height_in_the_vision: Invalid lens height in the Vision calibration.
cameraMap.could_not_open_the_camera_retrying: Could not open the camera ({imgBase}). Retrying...
cameraMap.not_homed_not_drawn: {axes} not homed: the image is not drawn (the positions are not real). Home to see it.
cameraMap.caption_calibration: Calibration {date}: at Y{y} Z{z}, image {size}, {ppm} px/mm, lens {h0} mm above Z0.
cameraMap.caption_now: Now (Y{y} Z{z}) the map assumes the camera sees {w} x {h} mm ({res}, {ppm} px/mm). Compare with a ruler on the bed.
cameraMap.caption_recalibrate: If you moved the camera since {date}, calibrate again in Vision.

cuts.guide_on_map: Draw with the tools on the left of the map or import an SVG. Then set the layers (power and speed per colour) and cut.
cuts.units_note: All the measures are in millimetres (mm), on the bed, where the beam lands. Center = the middle of the box of the selection; the edge fields move the left / bottom side.
cuts.nothing_to_paste: There is nothing copied: select shapes and press Copy first.
cuts.copy_failed: The browser did not let the copy be saved.
cuts.copied_n: {n} shape(s) copied. Paste them with Paste or Ctrl+V.
cuts.paste_tip: Pastes the copied shapes (Ctrl+V), 10 mm further each time.
cuts.copy_tip: Copies the selected shapes (also Ctrl+C). Paste puts them 10 mm further each time (Ctrl+V).
cuts.lin_bad: A linear array needs 2 to 400 copies and the steps X and Y.
cuts.lin_step_x: Step X (mm, from one to the next)
cuts.move_bad: Type the X and Y of the move (numbers or accounts).
cuts.move_by_tip: Moves the selection by an amount (X and Y in mm, they accept accounts like 120/3) or leaves it and puts a shifted copy.
cuts.bring_back_tip: Puts back on the area the shapes taken off after being cut, as not cut, so they can be cut again.
cuts.remove_cut_tip: They are kept (not deleted): use Bring back to put them on the area again, or Undo.
cuts.remove_cut_confirm: Tap again: the cut shapes leave the area
cuts.remove_cut: Take the cut ones off the area
cuts.cut_not_finished: The cut did not finish (it was cancelled or stopped): the shapes stay as not cut.
cuts.marked_as_cut: The cut finished: {n} shape(s) marked as cut (green, dashed).
cuts.columns_x_rows_between_1_and: Columns x rows between 1 and 400 copies.
cuts.rotate_each_copy_like_the_spokes: Rotate each copy (like the spokes of a wheel)
cuts.step_x_mm_from_one_copy: Step X (mm, from one copy to the next)
cuts.copies_in_a_grid_rows_x: Copies in a grid (rows x columns) or in a circle around a center.
cuts.removes_the_fixed_center_the_shape: Removes the fixed center: the shape can be moved again.
cuts.released_it_can_be_moved_now: Released: it can be moved now.
cuts.the_file_is_larger_than_5: The file is larger than 5 MB.
cuts.that_would_go_outside_the_cutting: That would go outside the work area: nothing was moved.
cuts.tap_again_delete_its_shapes_move: Tap again: delete (its shapes move to another layer)
cuts.selects_all_the_shapes_of_this: Selects all the shapes of this layer.
cuts.no_laser_materials_in_the_library: No laser materials in the library (Materials tab).
cuts.moves_the_selected_shapes_to_this: Moves the selected shapes to this layer.
cuts.cut_this_layer_earlier_e_g: Cut this layer earlier (e.g. engravings before the cut that frees the part).
cuts.locked_its_shapes_can_t_be: Locked: its shapes can't be touched or moved on the map (they are still cut).
cuts.off_shown_faint_on_the_map: Off: shown faint on the map and NOT cut.
cuts.air_assist_m42_p7_while_this: Air assist (M42 P7) while this layer is cut.
cuts.tap_new_shapes_go_to_this: Tap: new shapes go to this layer
cuts.new_layer_color_with_its_own: New layer (color) with its own power, speed, passes and air.
cuts.numbers_the_shapes_on_the_map: Numbers the shapes on the map in cutting order and draws the travel moves (laser off).
cuts.they_are_cut_from_top_to: They are cut from top to bottom. New shapes go to the active layer (blue border).
cuts.fixed_on_the_measured_center_it: Fixed on the measured center: it doesn't move. 'Release' to move it.
cuts.they_are_changed_in_layers_or: They are changed in Layers (or with Use material). Cutting power goes from 1 to 100 %.
cuts.air_assist_m42_p7_is_chosen: Air assist (M42 P7) is chosen per layer. Layers are cut in list order; turned-off ones aren't cut.
cuts.w_to_show_watts_limits_are: W (to show watts; limits are in %)
cuts.puts_the_selected_shape_in_the: Puts the selected shape in the Editor with its center here and keeps it fixed on this point.
cuts.creates_the_measured_shape_in_the: Creates the measured shape in the active layer, fixed on this center. Then you adjust it (e.g. a bit smaller) and cut it in the Editor.
cuts.moves_the_machine_so_the_spot: Moves the machine so the spot where the LASER hits sits on the center (with the laser-pointer correction; laser off).
cuts.tap_again_the_beam_sits_on: Tap again: the beam sits on the center
cuts.moves_the_machine_so_the_red: Moves the machine so the red POINTER sits on the center (laser off).
cuts.tap_again_the_pointer_goes_to: Tap again: the pointer goes to the center
cuts.faster_using_the_video_image_less: Faster, using the video image (less detail).
cuts.high_resolution_measuring_photo_where_th: High-resolution measuring photo where the camera is now (does not move the machine) and detection. A few seconds.
cuts.for_each_point_tap_the_map: For each point: tap the map near it, 'Go there', adjust with the jog until the POINTER is right on it and 'Capture point'.
cuts.the_camera_is_not_ready_for: The camera is not ready for Zones (calibrate it in Vision and turn on In Work zones): the machine is used.
cuts.the_camera_image_is_not_visible: The camera image is not visible on the map.
cuts.drag_the_camera_image_on_the: Drag the camera image on the map and the machine goes there (you confirm with Move). Wheel or pinch on the image raises or lowers Z: lower, more detail. When it stops, the camera searches again by itself.
cuts.the_camera_already_searches_by_itself: The camera already searches by itself on the video. This takes a high-resolution photo and searches again: more accurate, takes a few seconds.
cuts.nothing_useful_in_view_here_drag: Nothing useful in view here: drag the camera image to the part, or tap the edge by hand.
cuts.tap_an_orange_point_to_use: Tap an orange point to use it, or tap the edge on the image.
cuts.automatic_using_the_machine_the_camera: Automatic: using the machine (the camera is not calibrated or not enabled for Zones in Vision).
cuts.automatic_using_the_camera_it_is_2: Automatic: using the camera (it is calibrated); it still has to show on the map.
cuts.automatic_using_the_camera_it_is: Automatic: using the camera (it is calibrated and in view).
cuts.tap_a_number_in_the_drawing: Tap a number in the drawing to choose which point you capture (or take it again).
cuts.type_width_and_height_pick_the: Type width and height, pick the corner and capture it
cuts.done_more_well_spread_points_more: Done. More well-spread points = more accurate.
cuts.put_the_part_in_view_and: Put the part in view and tap Take photo.
cuts.the_midpoint_a_slot_between_two: The midpoint: a slot, between two holes.
cuts.what_do_you_want_to_measure: What do you want to measure?
cuts.measure_an_existing_hole_or_part: Measure an existing hole or part to know its center and size; then you can go there or center a cut on it.
cuts.moves_the_shapes_the_selection_or: Moves the shapes (the selection, or all of them) to the first free corner of that piece, with a 2 mm margin and clear of clamps.
cuts.when_you_drag_shapes_on_the: When you drag shapes on the map they snap to the zone's 0,0, center and edge. The dotted line is the distance from the 0,0.
cuts.the_zone_has_no_material_size: The zone has no material size (Zones > Edit > size).
cuts.centers_the_shapes_the_selection_or: Centers the shapes (the selection, or all of them if none) on the active zone's material.
cuts.puts_the_bottom_left_corner_of: Puts the bottom-left corner of the shapes (the selection, or all of them if none) on the 0,0 (material corner) of the active zone.
cuts.polyline_tap_the_map_point_by: Polyline: tap the map point by point (it snaps to vertices and references; the angle snaps like in Line). Finish or Close outline.
cuts.joins_the_last_point_to_the: Joins the last point to the first.
cuts.tap_shapes_or_drag_a_box: tap shapes or drag a box on the map
cuts.deletes_all_the_selected_shapes_at: Deletes all the selected shapes at once (Del). Undo brings them back.
cuts.on_each_tap_on_a_shape: On: each tap on a shape adds it to or removes it from the selection, and dragging on an empty spot of the map draws a box that selects everything it touches (on PC also with Shift).
cuts.draw_or_import_organize_by_layers: draw or import, organize by layers and cut
cuts.drag_to_rotate_the_selection_snaps: Drag to ROTATE the selection around the pivot (magnet of the chosen step; with Shift, free)
cuts.this_shape_is_fixed_on_the: This shape is fixed on the measured center: it can be enlarged, reduced or rotated, but not moved. 'Release' in the shape bar.
cuts.takes_the_pointer_there_laser_off: Takes the POINTER there (laser off); you adjust with the jog and capture the exact point.
cuts.pointer_going_to_the_point_adjust: Pointer going to the point. Adjust with the jog and tap Capture point.
cuts.takes_the_point_tapped_on_the: Takes the point tapped on the map as is, without moving the machine (less precise than bringing the pointer).
cuts.nothing_with_a_measurement_was_detected: Nothing with a measurement was detected. Try the measuring photo, more light or Vision's detection settings.
cuts.the_camera_is_not_calibrated_at: The camera is not calibrated at this height/resolution: calibrate it in Vision > Calibrate (without calibration there are no mm measurements).
cuts.takes_a_photo_detects_whole_holes: Takes a photo, detects whole holes and parts with their center and size; you tap the one you want.
cuts.the_camera_measures_the_whole_part: The camera measures the whole part
cuts.the_middle_between_two_points_a: The middle between two points: a slot, between two holes.
cuts.if_you_already_know_the_part: If you already know the part's width and height.
cuts.quick_if_the_sides_are_straight: Quick, if the sides are straight (parallel to X/Y).
cuts.one_touch_on_each_side_works: One touch on each side. Works with rounded or hidden corners.
cuts.any_order_also_detects_if_the: Any order. Also detects if the part is rotated.
cuts.if_you_already_know_the_diameter: If you already know the diameter: 2 points on the edge are enough.
cuts.the_most_accurate_with_more_than: The most accurate: with more than 3 points the error is averaged.
cuts.3_or_more_points_on_the: 3 or more points on the edge
cuts.the_camera_must_be_calibrated_in: The camera must be calibrated in Vision and set correctly (gantry or carriage in Layers).
cuts.with_the_camera_dragging_the_image: With the camera, dragging the image or the wheel moves the machine: always with a double tap.
cuts.a_fixed_shape_can_t_be: A fixed shape can't be dragged. It can be enlarged, reduced or rotated and stays on its center. Release frees it.
cuts.more_well_spread_points_give_a: More well-spread points give a more exact result. The deviation tells how round it is.
cuts.save_as_position_it_goes_to: Save as position: it goes to the jog positions and can be used as a zone point.
cuts.fix_the_selected_shape_here_moves: Fix the selected shape here: moves an Editor shape to this center and keeps it fixed.
cuts.create_circle_or_rectangle_to_cut: Create circle or rectangle to cut: it goes to the Editor, fixed on the measured center.
cuts.use_this_center_pointer_to_center: Use this center: Pointer to center or Laser to center (double tap, the machine moves).
cuts.when_done_you_get_the_center: When done you get the center and the size (diameter, or width, height and rotation).
cuts.with_the_camera_the_machine_can: With the camera, the machine can suggest points: tap one to use it.
cuts.capture_the_points_it_asks_for: Capture the points it asks for. The drawing marks the next one and the points stay on the map.
cuts.choose_where_the_points_come_from: Choose where the points come from: the machine (move the pointer and capture), the camera (tap on the image) or automatic.
cuts.choose_how_each_method_shows_in: Choose how: each method shows in a drawing where to touch.
cuts.choose_what_to_measure_a_hole: Choose what to measure: a hole or round part, a rectangular part, or the midpoint between two points.
cuts.find_center_measure_a_part_or: Find center: measure a part or a hole
cuts.wear_blue_laser_goggles_and_don: Wear blue-laser goggles and don't leave the machine alone while it cuts.
cuts.ctrl_z_undoes_ctrl_y_redoes: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes, Ctrl+D duplicates, Del deletes the selection, R rotates 90° to the right and Shift+R to the left.
cuts.everything_stays_inside_the_cutting_area: Everything stays inside the work area: what doesn't fit is not applied.
cuts.cutting_power_goes_from_1_to: Cutting power goes from 1 to 100 %. The 10 % limit is only for framing with the laser.
cuts.a_layer_that_is_off_is: A layer that is off is not cut. A locked layer is cut but can't be touched on the map.
cuts.layers_are_cut_from_top_to: Layers are cut from top to bottom: engrave before the cut that frees the part.
cuts.cut_check_the_list_of_layers: Cut: check the list of layers with their values, tick the safety box and tap CUT.
cuts.frame_with_the_pointer_or_with: Frame with the pointer or with the laser at low power to check where it will cut.
cuts.show_cut_order_numbers_the_shapes: Show cut order numbers the shapes in the order they are cut.
cuts.use_material_under_more_loads_power: Use material (under More) loads power, speed and passes from the Materials library.
cuts.in_layers_each_layer_has_power: In Layers, each layer has power %, speed in mm/min and passes. New shapes go to the active layer (blue border).
cuts.with_the_selection_duplicate_mirror_rota: With the selection: duplicate, mirror, align, distribute and copies in a grid or a circle. Rotate has its own group: 90° or the magnet step to each side, typed degrees, the pivot (centre, a corner or the 0,0 of the zone) and the angle magnet; on the map, the green handle turns around the pivot.
cuts.to_pick_several_shift_while_tapping: To pick several: Shift while tapping, or Multiple mode and a box.
cuts.tapping_a_shape_selects_it_dragging: Tapping a shape selects it. Dragging moves it. The corners resize it and the circle on top rotates it.
cuts.draw_a_shape_line_rectangle_circle: Draw a shape (line, rectangle, circle, polygon) by tapping the map, or import an SVG.
cuts.choose_the_zone_and_the_material: Choose the zone and the material at the top: the map shows the work area.
cuts.laser_editor_draw_arrange_in_layers: Laser editor: draw, arrange in layers and cut
cuts.circle_diam_mm_at_x_y: Circle diam {d} mm at X{c} Y{c2}
cuts.things_detected_tap_one_in_the: {n} things detected: tap one in the list or on the map.
cuts.there_are_no_shapes_or_all: there are no shapes (or all their layers are off)
cuts.the_machine_is_not_in_laser: the machine is not in Laser mode
cuts.there_is_no_known_laser_correction: there is no known laser correction (no zone has one)
cuts.the_cut_area_of_this_mode: the work area of this mode is not measured
cuts.with_the_laser_correction_it_goes: {name}: with the laser correction it goes outside the travel
cuts.the_shape_ended_up_too_small: The shape ended up too small (less than 0.5 mm): draw it again.
cuts.reaches_the_edge_of_the_cut: {v}-- reaches the edge of the work area
cuts.point_taken_from_the_camera_suggestion: Point {n} taken from the camera suggestion.
cuts.point_taken_from_the_camera_if: Point {n} taken from the camera. If it did not land right on the edge: tap its number on the drawing and tap again (bring the camera closer for more detail).
cuts.click_set_target_for_the_pointer: Click: set target for the pointer
cuts.the_line_snaps_to_multiples_of: The line snaps to multiples of {deg} degrees (0, 45, 90, 180...).
cuts.line_drag_on_the_map_from: Line: drag on the map from the start to the end
cuts.rectangle_drag_from_one_corner_to: Rectangle: drag from one corner to the opposite one
cuts.circle_drag_from_the_centre_to: Circle: drag from the centre to the edge
cuts.or_tap_the_second_point_the: -- or tap the second point (the first one is already marked).
cuts.choose_a_shape_and_draw_it: Choose a shape and draw it by DRAGGING on the map, or import an SVG. Then tap a shape to select it: blue handles = scale, green circle = rotate.
cuts.shape_s_go_over_a_clamp: ⚠ Shape(s) {list} go over a clamp (red on the map). Move them, or fix the clamp by tapping it on the map.
cuts.capture_point_of_2_of_the: Capture point {n} of 2 of the edge
cuts.the_2_points_are_mm_apart: The 2 points are {dd} mm apart: more than the diameter. Check the diameter or the points.
cuts.pointer_going_to_the_target_adjust: Pointer going to the target. Adjust with the jog and tap Capture point.
cuts.takes_the_pointer_to_the_target: Takes the POINTER to the target (laser off; raises Z 5 mm and lowers it on arrival). Then you adjust with the jog.{v}
cuts.use_the_point_tapped_on_the: Use the point tapped on the map as is, without moving the machine (less accurate).
cuts.tap_the_map_to_set_a: Tap the map to set a target (or move the pointer with the jog).
cuts.x_y_not_homed_homes_before: X/Y not homed: homes before capturing.
cuts.remove_drawing_tip: Removes from the map the points, the circle or rectangle found and what the camera detected. The chosen method stays.
cuts.with_2_points_and_the_diameter: With 2 points and the diameter there are two possible circles (the other one shows dotted on the map).
cuts.created_in_layer_fixed_at_the: {v} created in layer {name}, FIXED at the measured centre: in the Editor it can be enlarged, shrunk or rotated without shifting. It is cut from the Editor.
cuts.shape_centred_and_fixed_at_x: Shape centred and fixed at X{cx} Y{cy}: it can be edited without moving ('Release' to move it).
cuts.see_positions_tip: Opens Zones > Positions, where the saved positions are listed (go, rename, delete).
cuts.tap_centre_actions: Tap it: copy the G-code or save the position
cuts.position_saved_toast: Position '{nm}' saved. See it in Zones > Positions.
cuts.centre_laser_head: With the laser, the head ends at X{hx} Y{hy} (laser correction X{cx}); the laser spot lands at X{x} Y{y}.
cuts.adds_it_to_the_saved_positions: Adds it to the saved positions (the same ones as the jog, in the system): then 'Go' from the jog, or use it as the point of a zone or a corner of the work area.
cuts.copies_a_line_to_go_to: Copies a line to go to the centre (G53 = machine coordinates, the POINTER ends up on top; S0 = laser off). Useful to paste in the console or in a macro.
cuts.no_shapes_use_line_rectangle_circle: No shapes. Use + Line / + Rectangle / + Circle and tap on the map, or Find centre.
cuts.rotate_the_line_to_degrees_from: Rotate the line to {a} degrees from the start, same length.
cuts.laser_power_saved_w_for_all: Laser power saved: {w} W (for all screens).
cuts.takes_x_to_y_to_estimated: Takes X{xmin} to {xmax}, Y {ymin} to {ymax}  ·  estimated time ~{min} min (without accelerations)
cuts.power_only_for_framing_not_the: Power ONLY for framing (not the cut one), maximum {max} % -- {pct} % ~ {w} W
cuts.cut_shape_s_power_up_to: CUT {n} shape(s), power up to {maxPow} % (~{w} W of {tjLaserWatts} W), ~{min} min. Check: material fixed, focus done (Measure and focus), air/extraction, nothing flammable around. Runs as a JOB: Pause/Cancel in DWC or Emergency Stop stop it.
cuts.goes_around_the_rectangle_taken_by: {v}Goes around the rectangle taken by the shapes with the beam at {pct} %.
cuts.wear_protection_glasses_for_blue_laser: Wear protection glasses for blue laser (445-455 nm) and do not look at the spot directly.
cuts.i_have_the_glasses_on_and: I have the glasses on and checked the path
cuts.cut_running_pause_cancel_in_dwc: Cut running. Pause/Cancel in DWC or Emergency Stop stop it.
cuts.it_does_not_fit_in_the: It does not fit in the work area: the change was not applied.
cuts.the_copies_do_not_fit_in: The copies do not fit in the work area ({n} shapes). Try fewer copies or less spacing.
cuts.loads_power_speed_and_passes_from: Loads power, speed and passes from the materials library (Materials tab).
cuts.has_no_material_size_cannot_centre: {code} has no material size: cannot centre (Zones > Edit > size).
cuts.has_no_paths_to_cut_if: {name}: has no paths to cut (if it has text, convert it to path/curves in Inkscape: Path > Object to Path).
cuts.too_much_detail_points_simplify_it: {name}: too much detail ({total} points). Simplify it before importing.
cuts.it_was_larger_than_the_cut: It was larger than the work area: it was scaled down to {v} %.
cuts.imported_paths_x_mm_colour_s: Imported {name}: {shapesLen} paths, {v} x {v2} mm, {keysLen} colour(s)/layer(s).{fitMsg} It is selected: move, scale or rotate it with the handles or the numbers.
cuts.when_scaling_handles_or_width_height: When scaling (handles or Width/Height), keep the proportion.
cuts.careful_the_target_is_outside_the: CAREFUL: the target is outside the work area.
cuts.warning_is_more_than_it_may: WARNING: {pct} % is more than {warn} %, it may mark the material.
cuts.careful_it_ends_up_outside_the: CAREFUL: it ends up outside the work area.
cuts.careful_the_corners_do_not_form: ·  CAREFUL: the corners do not form a right angle ({squareErr} degrees of error)
cuts.aim_laser_note: You put the LASER SPOT on the edge: the head position minus the correction X{x} Y{y} is stored (red dot on the map). 'Go there' takes the laser to the point.
cuts.aim_pointer_note: You put the POINTER on the edge (white cross on the map). If you aim with the laser choose 'Laser spot': the laser hits X{x} Y{y} away from the pointer and the result would be shifted.
cuts.aim_pointer_note_no_correction: You put the POINTER on the edge (white cross on the map). To aim with the laser, first measure the laser-pointer correction in Offsets.
cuts.deviation_exact: Deviation: 0 mm, the shape passes exactly through {list}.
cuts.deviation_circle: Deviation of the points from the circle: {rms} mm (average), maximum {max} mm at {p}. The number next to each point on the map is its deviation (+ outside, - inside).
cuts.deviation_rect3: Deviation: the 3 corners are not square ({deg} degrees): the drawn outline passes through all 3 and the fourth is {mm} mm off a perfect rectangle.
cuts.how_circle: How it is computed: the circle that best fits all the points (least squares). With 3 points it passes exactly through them; with more it averages and the deviation says how far they are.
cuts.how_circle2: How it is computed: with 2 edge points and the diameter there are two possible circles, one on each side; 'Use the other circle' switches side.
cuts.how_rect3: How it is computed: the 2 corners farthest apart are the diagonal and the centre is its midpoint; the third gives the rotation and the sides.
cuts.how_rect2: How it is computed: centre = midpoint of the 2 opposite corners; sides parallel to X and Y.
cuts.how_edges: How it is computed: centre X = halfway between the left and right edges; Y = halfway between bottom and top.
cuts.how_rect1: How it is computed: from the touched corner, half of the typed size is added towards the inside of the part.
cuts.how_mid: How it is computed: the midpoint between the 2 points.
cuts.need_active_zone: there is no active work zone: choose one in Prepare
cuts.need_material: zone {zone} has no laser material assigned: assign one in Materials
cuts.need_focus: zone {zone} is not focused for {material}: measure the focus in Prepare (Measure and focus) or with Focus here
cuts.rotate_left_step: Rotate {n}° to the left (the magnet step)
cuts.rotate_right_step: Rotate {n}° to the right (the magnet step)
cuts.rotate_apply_tip: Rotates the selection by the degrees typed around the pivot. Enter too.

job.long_job_samples_were_reduced_so: Long job: samples were reduced so the file does not grow.
job.job_without_a_file_live_the: Job without a file (live): while it runs the map draws the machine position up to 10 times a second; the recorded path keeps a sample every 0.25 s, so curves and corners look approximate.
job.could_not_read_the_path_from: Could not read the path from the file: the position samples are shown, approximate.
job.reading_the_path_from_the_file: Reading the path from the file...
job.this_is_the_exact_path_from_2: This is the exact path from the file.
job.this_is_the_exact_path_from: This is the exact path from the file: what is left shows faint.
job.on_the_map_milling_light_blue: On the map: milling = light blue (shallow) to violet (deep); travel = dashed gray.
job.removed_from_the_map_the_next: Removed from the map. The next job shows up by itself when it starts.
job.no_job_recorded_yet_when_one: No job recorded yet. When one starts (laser cut or milling; from a file or live), what is being done shows up here.
job.deletes_the_last_job_s_trace: Deletes the last job's trace (for all screens); its copy stays in the history. Tap twice.
job.hides_this_job_s_path_on: Hides this job's path on the map (this screen only). The next job shows up by itself.
job.deletes_all_saved_jobs_tap_twice: Deletes all saved jobs. Tap twice.
job.deletes_this_job_from_the_history: Deletes this job from the history. Tap twice.
job.no_saved_jobs_yet_every_job: No saved jobs yet. Every job that finishes (file, live or macro) is saved here automatically; the last 50 are kept.
job.on_the_map_cut_yellow_low: On the map: cut = yellow (low power) to red (high); travel = dotted grey.
job.trace_needs_operator: The path of the jobs is shown to the operator role or higher: sign in with that role to see it.
job.path_drawn_progress_updates: The whole path is already drawn; the progress updates every few seconds ({pct} %).
job.drawn_when_it_ends: Live job: the map draws where it goes while it runs; when it ends the recorded path takes its place.
job.other_mode_job: This job is of the {mode} mode: it is shown on the {page} page.

large.this_part_was_cut_without_marks: This part was cut without marks: there is no way to measure the piece. Use Start over or place it again by hand.
large.confirm_the_machine_moves_the_camera: Confirm: the machine moves the camera
large.with_the_pointer_bring_the_red_2: With the pointer: bring the red dot to the center of each cross with the jog and tap Capture.
large.move_the_piece_and_locate_it: Move the piece and locate it
large.the_machine_is_busy_wait_for: The machine is busy: wait for it to finish.
large.3_crosses_of_5_mm_on: 3 crosses of 5 mm on the material, away from the lines, on the side of what is left. They must be clearly visible: if faint, raise the power a little.
large.green_what_is_cut_now_dashed: Green = what is cut now; dashed orange = what is left for later.
large.or_drag_the_design_on_the: Or drag the design on the map to where your piece is:
large.with_the_pointer_bring_the_red: With the pointer: bring the red dot there with the jog and tap Pointer here. The map works if the map camera shows the piece.
large.distance_from_the_design_to_the: Distance from the design to the edges
large.b_another_point_of_the_front: b) Another point of the front edge, further right
large.mark_2_points_of_your_piece: Mark 2 points of your piece and the design places itself inside it, square with the edge:
large.no_g_code_in_the_gcodes: No G-code in the gcodes folder
large.first_measure_the_cutting_area_of: First measure the work area of this mode (Work area tab).
large.cuts_in_parts_a_design_larger: Cuts in parts a design larger than the work area. Between parts you move the piece by hand: the laser marks 3 small crosses and then the camera (or the pointer) finds them to continue exactly where it left off. You don't have to add anything to your design.
large.the_two_points_are_too_close: The two points are too close: the edge point must be at least 10 mm from the corner.
large.at_least_2_measured_marks_are: At least 2 measured marks are needed.
large.the_camera_is_looking_for_the: The camera is looking for the marks (the machine moves the camera, no laser)...
large.first_cut_the_part_and_move: First cut the part and move the piece.
large.burning_the_3_registration_marks_wait: Burning the 3 registration marks. Wait for it to finish before cutting.
large.reading_the_file_on_the_system: Reading the file on the system...
large.no_response_from_the_system_service: no response from the system service
large.cutting_part_mm_when_it_finishes: Cutting part {n} ({mm} mm). When it finishes, tap "The part came out fine".
large.the_camera_found_of_3_marks: The camera found {found} of 3 marks. Check on the map and tap Calculate.
large.the_camera_found_only_mark_s: The camera found only {found} mark(s): look for the others with the pointer.
large.piece_located_rotation_degrees_maximum: Piece located: rotation {rotation} degrees, maximum difference between marks {err} mm.
large.difference_of_mm_between_the_marks: Difference of {err} mm between the marks: one was taken wrong or the piece bent. Measure again before cutting.
large.disabled_the_machine_is_in_mode: Disabled: the machine is in {mode} mode. This wizard is only for the laser.
large.size_x_mm_m_of_cut: Size {w} x {hh} mm · {m} m of cut · maximum power {pct_max} %{v2}
large.part_1_mm_of_cut_mm: Part 1: {this_mm} mm of cut. {missing_mm} mm remain for the next parts.
large.part_rotation_degrees_0_0_of: Part {n}: rotation {rotation} degrees, 0,0 of the design at X{tx} Y{ty}.
large.shift_the_piece_roughly_without_rotating: Shift the piece roughly {v}, without rotating it much. On the map: the circles are where the crosses should end up; no precision needed, it is measured afterwards.
large.the_parts_of_the_design_were: The {n} parts of the design were cut.
large.tap_the_front_left_corner_of: Tap the front left corner of the piece
large.tap_another_point_of_the_front: Tap another point of the front edge
large.tap_the_0_0_of_your: Tap: the 0,0 of your design goes here
large.fits_whole_in_the_area_this: · fits whole in the area: this wizard is not needed

tzTips.t_new_zone: Create a new work zone (G55..G59.3): an origin saved in the system that survives restarts.
tzTips.t_export_json: Download all the zones to a file (backup).
tzTips.t_import_json: Load zones from a file exported before.
tzTips.t_use: Activate this zone (G55, G56...). Does not move the machine.
tzTips.t_go_to_x0_y0: Activates the zone and MOVES the machine to its X0 Y0. Raises Z to a safe height first. Asks for a second tap.
tzTips.t_edit: Change name, point or correction (history is kept).
tzTips.t_create: Save an origin for this zone.
tzTips.t_copy_to: Create another zone with the same data.
tzTips.t_history: Previous versions of this zone; they can be restored.
tzTips.t_restore: Go back to this version (the current one stays in the history).
tzTips.t_delete: Delete. Asks for a second tap.
tzTips.t_measure_with_pointer: You take the pointer to each corner with the jog and capture.
tzTips.t_measure_with_laser: Same as with the pointer, but you aim with the laser dot (the correction is applied).
tzTips.t_measure_by_hand: Releases the X/Y motors, you move the head by hand and the machine measures by itself against the end stops.
tzTips.t_measure_from_the_map: You tap the approximate corner on the map, the machine goes there and you adjust with the jog.
tzTips.t_draw_rectangle: Draw the area on the map (two corners), adjust the numbers, test it and save.
tzTips.t_from_saved_positions: Use two saved positions (jog > Saved positions) as opposite corners of the area. Then it is adjusted, tested and saved.
tzTips.t_use_these_corners: Go to the adjustment step (numbers, test with the head/laser and save).
tzTips.t_frame: Goes around the edge with the POINTER (laser off, S0). Useful to see if the material fits.
tzTips.t_frame_pointer: Goes around the edge of the job with the POINTER (laser off, S0). Asks for a second tap.
tzTips.t_frame_with_laser: Goes around the edge with the laser at low power (4 % by default, maximum 10 %). Asks for confirmation.
tzTips.t_start_framing: Starts the laser framing as a job: it can be Paused/Cancelled from DWC.
tzTips.t_remove: Delete the work area of the active mode.
tzTips.t_save_area: Save this work area for the active mode.
tzTips.t_test_with_the_head: Goes around the rectangle with the POINTER to see it on the bed (laser off).
tzTips.t_test_with_the_laser: Goes around the rectangle with the laser at low power. Asks for confirmation.
tzTips.t_draw_again: Discards this rectangle and starts again.
tzTips.t_go_to_the_point: The machine takes the pointer to the point chosen on the map.
tzTips.t_capture_corner: Save the current position as this corner.
tzTips.t_release_x_y_motors: Turns X and Y off (Z stays firm) to move the head by hand.
tzTips.t_motors_released: X and Y are released: move the head by hand.
tzTips.t_use_current_position: Copies the current position of the POINTER (machine coordinates) to the zone point.
tzTips.t_zoom_in: Zoom in on the map (also mouse wheel or pinch).
tzTips.t_line: Draw a line: drag on the map (or tap start and end).
tzTips.t_rectangle: Draw a rectangle: drag on the map from one corner to the opposite one.
tzTips.t_circle: Draw a circle: drag from the centre outwards.
tzTips.t_circle_2: Find the centre of a circle: capture 3 or more points of the edge with the pointer.
tzTips.t_rectangle_2: Find the centre of a rectangle: capture 3 corners with the pointer.
tzTips.t_capture_point: Save the current pointer position as one more point.
tzTips.t_go_to_the_centre: Takes the pointer to the computed centre. Asks for a second tap.
tzTips.t_create_circle: Add to Simple cuts a circle with this centre and diameter.
tzTips.t_create_rectangle: Add to Simple cuts a rectangle with this size.
tzTips.t_centre_shape_here: Move the selected shape so that its centre is on the centre found.
tzTips.t_start_pointer: Put the start of the line where the pointer is now.
tzTips.t_corner_pointer: Put the corner of the rectangle where the pointer is now.
tzTips.t_centre_pointer: Put the centre of the circle where the pointer is now.
tzTips.t_end_pointer: Put the end of the line where the pointer is now.
tzTips.t_apply_to_all: Copy power, speed and passes of this shape to all the shapes.
tzTips.t_cut: Prepare the cut (does not move anything yet; asks for confirmation).
tzTips.t_cut_2: Starts the cut as a job: Pause/Cancel in DWC or Emergency Stop stop it.

tv.from_here_done: Created {f}; {q} line(s) that are not safe to repeat (homing, pauses, G92...) were left out. Review it and start it.
tv.from_here_relative: The file is in relative mode (G91) at that point: it cannot be started in the middle.
tv.from_here_end: The simulation is at the end: move it back first.
tv.from_here_only_laser: Starting in the middle only works for Laser jobs (the Z and the extrusion of the skipped part are not known).
tv.from_here_confirm: Tap again: the file starts from this point
tv.from_here_tip: Makes a new file that starts where the simulation is (the machine goes there with the laser off, then it goes on with the file). It is not started: it opens in the preview to review it.
tv.board_w_inch: A file uses inches (G20): its shift was converted, check it.
tv.board_w_macros: {n} macro call(s) (M98) inside the files: what they do is not shifted.
tv.board_w_g92: {n} line(s) with G92 / G10 change the coordinate system by themselves: the shift may not follow them. Check the result.
tv.board_w_g53: {n} move(s) in machine coordinates (G53) were not moved (parking...). Check them.
tv.board_w_rel: {n} line(s) in relative mode (G91) were not moved: they follow the move before them.
tv.board_open: Open the joint job to review it
tv.board_created: Created {f}. It is NOT started: open it to look at it first.
tv.board_building: Reading the files and building the joint job...
tv.board_fix_first: Fix the red jobs before creating the file.
tv.board_overlap: {a} and {b} are on top of each other (less than 2 mm between them).
tv.board_outside: {f} goes out of the work area.
tv.out_of_area: This job goes out of the work area: {sides}.
tv.out_of_area_hint: Check whether the design program already compensates the laser offset (the active zone applies it too) and which zone is used: the simulation uses {zone} and does not see zone changes inside macros.
tv.send_confirm_outside: WARNING: it goes out of the area. Tap again to send {f} anyway
tv.board_not_all_fit: {n} job(s) do not fit in the area: they stay where they were.
tv.board_no_area: Measure the work area of this mode first (Work area tab): the board needs it to check that the jobs fit.
tv.board_ok: All the jobs fit inside the work area and none touches another.
tv.board_arrange_tip: Places the jobs in rows inside the work area with 5 mm between them (the tallest first).
tv.board_help: Move each job with X and Y (mm, over the area) or press Arrange. They are drawn on the map in their colour; red = out of the area or on top of another.
tv.board_mode: The board only holds jobs of the same mode (Laser or CNC).
tv.board_already: That job is already on the board.
tv.board_add_tip: Puts this job on the board to place several jobs on the area, check that they fit and send them together.
tv.sent: The job was sent to the machine.
tv.send_help: After looking at it, it starts as a normal job on the machine, in the work zone that is active now: {zone}. Check the zone and the material before.
tv.tab_tip: Pick a job file, see it on the map with its data and chart, simulate it, frame it and send it. It does not touch the job in progress.
tv.clean_tip: Takes the previewed job and the path of the last job off the map so you see the table clean. Nothing is deleted: the last job comes back with the next job, or from its own card above.
tv.title: Jobs: view, simulate and frame
tv.help: Pick a G-code file of the job list to see it on the map and decide what to do with it. Nothing is run: the file is only read.
tv.time_tip: Worked out from the feed of each move (G1) and the rapid speed of the axes (G0). Pauses, M400 and acceleration are not counted, so the real time is a little longer.
tv.pieces_tip: Groups of work separated by a travel.
tv.simplified: The map shows {n} of {t} vertices; the numbers are exact.
tv.chart: The job over time: the height is the power (or depth) while it works, the grey line is a travel.
tv.frame_help: The cyan dashed line on the map is what will be traced. Box = the rectangle around the job; Outline = the shape around it. With the pointer the machine moves and nothing burns. It does NOT make a job: you choose how many times and you can stop it.
tv.power_warn: Above {v} % wear the glasses and watch the path.
tv.frame_confirm: Tap again: the machine moves around the job
tv.frame_confirm_laser: Tap again: the LASER turns on and the machine moves around the job
tv.machine_busy: The machine is busy or running a job.
tv.framing: Framing. It is not a job: the service moves the machine in short pieces; Stop ends it within a second.
tv.frame_outside_axes: That frame goes outside the travel of the axes (with the laser correction).

space.inspector_tip: Shows or hides the panel of the open tool (on a narrow screen)
space.head: Head
space.job_cancel_confirm: Tap again to cancel the job
space.block_signed_out: Locked: not signed in, you can only look. Sign in to move the machine.
space.block_view_only: Locked: your role can only look.
space.block_off: Locked: machine off (the power supply is off).
space.block_disconnected: Locked: no connection with the board.
space.block_not_homed: Not homed: home the machine to be able to move.
