startup_workbench.mode_tip: The mode (laser or CNC) comes from the machine; the Workbench shows the tools of that mode.
startup_workbench.macro_tip: The Workbench uses it to switch mode. If your machine does not have that mode it stays grey.
startup_workbench.probe_tip: Needed for Level Z, Mesh and measuring the focus. Without a probe those tools do not apply.
startup_workbench.cutarea_tip: The real limits of the machine, measured in the Area tab.
startup_workbench.cutarea_missing: The Workbench does not know how far your machine reaches. Measure it in the Area tab.
startup_workbench.zone_tip: At least one zone (zone file on the SD) where the material goes.
startup_workbench.zone_missing: There is nowhere to place the job. Create a zone.
startup_workbench.material_tip: At least one material with its cutting parameters.
startup_workbench.material_missing: Jobs will use unadjusted values. Create at least one material.
startup_workbench.homezhere_tip: Sets Z0 with the probe at the current position. Only applies with a probe.
startup_workbench.mode_what: The current mode of the machine: laser or CNC.
startup_workbench.mode_for: The Workbench shows only the tools of that mode.
startup_workbench.mode_missing: The Workbench does not know which tools to show. Choose a mode.
startup_workbench.macro_laser_what: A macro that switches the machine to laser mode.
startup_workbench.macro_laser_for: The Workbench uses it to change mode.
startup_workbench.macro_laser_missing: You cannot switch to this mode from the Workbench. If your machine does not have it, the row stays grey.
startup_workbench.macro_cnc_what: A macro that switches the machine to CNC mode.
startup_workbench.macro_cnc_for: The Workbench uses it to change mode.
startup_workbench.macro_cnc_missing: You cannot switch to this mode from the Workbench. If your machine does not have it, the row stays grey.
startup_workbench.probe_what: The probe that measures heights (a BLTouch or another).
startup_workbench.probe_for: Level Z, the mesh and the focus measurement use it.
startup_workbench.probe_missing: Those tools do not apply. Without a probe the row stays grey.
startup_workbench.cutarea_what: The real limits of your machine, measured in the Area tab.
startup_workbench.cutarea_for: The Workbench uses them to send nothing outside the bed.
startup_workbench.zone_what: A work zone: the place on the bed where you put the material.
startup_workbench.material_what: A material with its cutting parameters (speed, power).
startup_workbench.material_for: Every job takes its values from there.
startup_workbench.homezhere_what: An example macro that sets Z0 with the probe where you are.
startup_workbench.homezhere_for: The Workbench offers it as a shortcut.
startup_workbench.homezhere_missing: That shortcut will not be there. It only applies with a probe.
startup_workbench.q_raise: How far to raise before measuring (mm)
startup_workbench.q_raise_tip: Z goes up this far so nothing is touched at the start. 5 mm is fine for almost everything.
startup_workbench.q_feed_tip: How fast Z goes up. 3000 is the usual.
startup_workbench.q_probe_tip: The K number of your probe (M558 in config.g). The first one is 0.
startup_workbench.q_thickness: Also measure the thickness of what is on the bed?
startup_workbench.q_thickness_tip: If you already have a bed reference, it works out the thickness of the material after measuring.

cnc.tab_tip: Draw lines, rectangles, circles and pockets and make a G-code file with passes by depth (CNC mode only).
cnc.title: CNC toolpaths
cnc.intro: Draw the shapes, say how deep to cut and make the file. All values are in mm. Z0 must be the top of the material and X Y are bed coordinates. The file is only written: you start it yourself.
cnc.disabled_mode: Disabled: the machine is in {mode} mode. Switch to CNC to use the toolpaths.
cnc.name: Name
cnc.delete_design_confirm: This design is deleted from the machine. Tap again to confirm.
cnc.read_only: The design file was written by a newer version: it is not overwritten.
cnc.material_tip: Takes feed, spindle speed, safe height and step from the CNC materials. What you type in the tool fields wins.
cnc.diameter_tip: Cutter diameter. Needed to offset the path and to keep the cutter inside the area.
cnc.feed_tip: Cutting speed. Empty = the one of the material.
cnc.plunge_tip: Speed going down in Z. Empty = half of the feed.
cnc.rpm_tip: Spindle speed written as M3 S. Empty = the one of the material.
cnc.step_tip: Maximum depth of each pass. Empty = the one of the material.
cnc.safe_z_tip: Height above the surface for travel moves between shapes. Empty = the one of the material.
cnc.approach_z_tip: Height above the surface where the cutter slows down to enter the material. Never above the safe Z.
cnc.stepover_tip: Fraction of the diameter between the rings of a pocket.
cnc.units_tip: Units of the G-code file (G21 mm or G20 inches). You always type mm here.
cnc.direction_tip: Direction of the cut around shapes and circles.
cnc.spindle_manual_tip: The file does not start or stop the spindle (M3 / M5): you turn it on yourself before starting.
cnc.no_shapes: No shapes yet. Add one and place it on the map.
cnc.depth_tip: Total depth below the surface (positive). It is cut in passes of at most the step down.
cnc.side_tip: Where the cutter goes: on the line, inside the shape (holes) or outside it (parts).
cnc.summary: {passes} pass(es), {length} mm of cutting, about {minutes} min.
cnc.job_tip: Create file writes a .gcode in 0:/gcodes and does not move the machine. Start asks for a second tap and needs the machine free and in CNC mode.
cnc.start_confirm: Start the file now? Check the cutter, the Z zero and the spindle.
cnc.file_created: File created: {path}. Check it and start it when ready.
cnc.file_stale: The design changed after the file was made: create the file again.
cnc.mode_is_not_cnc: The machine is not in CNC mode.
cnc.err_depth: {shape}: the depth must be more than 0.
cnc.err_step: The step down is missing or invalid (set it in the tool or in the material).
cnc.err_feed: The feed is missing (set it in the tool or in the material).
cnc.err_height_safe: The safe Z is missing (set it in the tool or in the material).
cnc.err_spindle: No spindle speed: set the rpm or tick Spindle by hand.
cnc.err_geometry: {shape}: the numbers of the shape are not valid.
cnc.err_tool_large: {shape}: the cutter does not fit in the shape.
cnc.err_outside_z: Deeper than the Z travel of the machine ({route} mm).
cnc.warn_step_large: The step down ({step} mm) is more than twice the cutter diameter.
cnc.warn_crosses: {shape}: the cut goes through the material.
cnc.warn_area_machine: The work area is not measured: the limits of the axes are used.

commands.placeholder: Type to search tools and actions
commands.footer: Up and Down choose, Enter opens, Shift+Enter marks a favorite, Esc closes.
commands.undo_help: Undoes the last local change (shapes, map view). It never undoes an order sent to the machine.
commands.zone_active_help: Opens the card of the active zone.
commands.measure_help: Turns the map ruler on or off.
commands.measure_no_here: The ruler is not available in this tab.
commands.adjust: Fit the map to the whole bed
commands.adjust_help: Removes the zoom and the pan.
commands.screen_help: Enters or leaves the full screen of the map.
commands.favorite_current: Mark or unmark the open tool as favorite
commands.favorite_help: Favorites come first in the palette.
commands.step_help: Opens the first tool of this group.
commands.step_empty: This group has no tools in the {mode} mode.
commands.no_available: That tool is not available here.
commands.busy: The machine is busy: that action waits.

shortcuts.personalizar: Tap the star to mark favourites and the key of each row to change it (Esc cancels, Backspace removes it).
shortcuts.reservado: That key is used by the browser, the editor or the Jog.
shortcuts.invalid: That key cannot be a shortcut.
shortcuts.footer: Shortcuts: / or Ctrl+K search, 1 to 5 step, G active zone, M measure, Esc cancel, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y redo.

role.technicians_only_tip: Your role cannot use it. Ask a technician to do it or log in with a technician account.

ready.title: Ready to cut
ready.laser_only: The cut check is for Laser mode.
ready.mode_bad: The machine is not in Laser mode.
ready.mode_role: Your role does not operate in {mode} mode: ask the administrator to enable it.
ready.zone_bad: The active zone has no file.
ready.material_bad: The zone has no laser material.
ready.focus_bad: It needs focusing: measure and focus the zone (Prepare).
ready.area_bad: The work area of the mode is missing.
ready.design_bad: The design has {n} thing(s) to fix.
ready.frame_optional: Frame with the pointer: optional, done or not.
ready.lid_hw: Lid: watched by the machine interlock.
ready.extraction_hw: Extraction: watched by the machine interlock.
ready.safety_glasses: I have the protective glasses on.
ready.safety_clear: Nobody is inside the work area.
ready.safety_lid_hw: The lid is watched by the machine interlock.
ready.safety_extraction_hw: The extraction is watched by the machine interlock.
ready.safety_needed: Tick the laser safety list before cutting.

livejob.stop_unavailable: The safe stop is not available: {reason}
livejob.in_progress_tip: To stop it safely use the button of the control side bar.
livejob.card_empty: No interrupted jobs. When you stop one safely, it shows up here with the point where it stopped.
livejob.where: It stopped at line {line} (X {x}, Y {y}) · {mm} mm cut
livejob.blocker_rebooted: The board restarted at {time}, {min} min after the stop (the stop restarts nothing: it is usually a power cut or a supply drop): the origins and offsets were lost. Start again.
livejob.blocker_machine_unknown: The state of the machine is not known: wait for it to answer.
livejob.blocker_job_running: A job is running: resume cannot be armed.
livejob.blocker_machine_busy: The machine is busy: wait until it is free.
livejob.blocker_role: Your role cannot resume jobs: you need to be an operator.
livejob.view_path_tip: Draws on the map what was cut and where it stopped.
livejob.restart_tip: Discards this record and lets you send the job from scratch.
livejob.tap_again_restart: Tap again: discard and start again
livejob.restart_done: Record discarded: send the job from scratch from the program.
livejob.take_off_tip: Stops showing it on the map. It does NOT delete it: it stays in this list with the point where it stopped.
livejob.put_back_tip: Shows it on the map again.
livejob.off_the_table: Off the table (still in the list).
livejob.help_take_off: Take off the table only hides it from the map and keeps it listed; Discard and Start again do delete the record.
livejob.step1_text: The machine will go near X {x}, Y {y} (program coordinates) with the laser off and continue from line {line}. If the workpiece or the origin moved since it stopped, that is not detected: check it first.
livejob.overlap_label: Go back and cut again, so the join is not short:
livejob.step2_text: A confirmation will be asked. It stays armed for 30 minutes.
livejob.step3_title: Send the same job again from the program
livejob.step3_wait: Waiting for the job from the program…
livejob.step4_title: It is checked to be the same one
livejob.step4_idle: It is compared line by line without moving anything.
livejob.step4_approach: Verified: going to the point with the laser off…
livejob.step4_done: Done: the job goes on from there.
livejob.step4_mismatch: It is not the same job: {reason}. Nothing was run; arm again or start again.
livejob.tab_tip: Live jobs that were stopped safely or cut by a reboot: where they stopped and how to resume them.
livejob.tab_intro: When a live job is stopped safely, it stays here with the point where it stopped. From here it is resumed (step by step, verified) or discarded.
livejob.job_line: {n} interrupted job(s) to check or resume
livejob.help_what: An interrupted job is a live job (from the program, over the network or USB) that was stopped with "Stop safely" or cut by a reboot of the board.
livejob.help_resume: Resume: choose the overlap, arm, send the same job again from the program; the machine checks it is the same one and goes on from where it stopped.
livejob.help_restart: Start again or Discard delete the record (tap twice).
livejob.help_map: On the map: what was cut in amber, the travels dashed grey and a ring where it stopped.
